title: Explanatory Note to the Equity Statement: The Grain Volume a Fiscal Year Already Stands Accrued At
content:
A member reading an equity statement under Membership and Patronage Equity may see more than one figure for the grain volume of a closed fiscal year: the volume the year's patronage notice was posted on, the volume of the accrual lines recorded against the year, and, where the year has been restated, the volume the restatement carries. Which of them is the volume the year already stands accrued at is settled as follows.

**Where the accrual lines have overtaken the notice.** Where an allocation notice stands posted for the year on the grain basis and the accrual lines recorded for the year on that basis carry more volume than it was posted on, the volume already standing accrued is the sum of those accrual lines.

**Where a restatement stands.** Where a restatement stands on the equity ledger for the year most recently allocated on the grain basis and the accrual lines carry no more volume than the notice was posted on, the volume already standing accrued is read from the latest such restatement.

**Otherwise.** The volume already standing accrued is read from the allocation notice posted for that year on the grain basis.

## The three readings side by side, on hypothetical figures

| Volume the notice was posted on | Sum of the accrual lines for the year | Latest restatement for the year | Volume already standing accrued |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 28000.00 | 31200.00 | none | 31200.00 |
| 28000.00 | 26400.00 | 29750.00 | 29750.00 |
| 28000.00 | 26400.00 | none | 28000.00 |
| 28000.00 | 28000.00 | 29750.00 | 29750.00 |

**On the fourth line.** Accrual lines that come to exactly the volume the notice was posted on do not carry more than it; they carry no more than it, so where a restatement stands for the year it is the restatement that is read.

**Where no notice stands posted.** The first reading asks for a notice standing posted for the year, so where none stands the accrual lines do not displace it, and the volume already standing accrued is read from the notice line for the year as it stands.
